title: Package registered with another signing key
summary: The package com.example.test is registered, but not for the signing key checked in this build.
steps: Compare the checked certificate fingerprint AA:BB with the signing keys registered for com.example.test.
Confirm which developer and which distribution channel use each registered signing key; the package may be associated with a different developer.
If this signing key should be covered, follow the official registration guidance to add and verify the key.
